sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We are willing to accommodate your request for 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract, provided we agree on a price of €52.20.
This reflects a fair compromise that respects our long-standing relationship while addressing the reality of our cost increases.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €52.20 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We note your latest message, but we are surprised to see your proposed price decrease from your previous offer.
We have already made significant concessions on payment terms and contract duration to support our long-standing relationship, and our offer of €52.20 remains firm.
Please provide the detailed data behind your internal benchmark, as we cannot adjust our pricing based on unverified figures.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material and we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that notice period data into account. 

To support our long-standing relationship, we have already accommodated your requests for 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract. Consequently, €52.20 is our final offer for this package. 

Our offer stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
